name: tda
description: UX and visual judgment for agent-built UI: a build brief before you build, a scored review after.

interface.shortDescription: A build brief before you build a screen, a scored UX and visual review after.
interface.longDescription: TheDesignAgent gives your coding agent design judgment. Before it builds a screen, it gets a brief calibrated to your product, your users' jobs and your design system. After, it gets a 0-10 UX and visual score from a real screenshot, with findings to fix. Project context is stored, so every review sharpens the next brief.
